newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Asian dollar deposits little changed in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Asian dollar deposits little changed in late trade.

text.p: Asian dollar deposit rates were little changed in featureless trade with most traders sidelined ahead of tonight's release of the weekly jobless claims data, dealers said on Thursday.
Weekly jobless claims for the week ended April 5, are forecast to be around 313,000 compared with 314,000 reported in the previous week.

"The market was quiet and featureless in the morning on lack fresh factors. The market is now waiting for fresh clues to market direction from tonight's release of the weekly jobless claims figures," a local dealer said.

Among longer dates, two-months was unchanged at 5-3/4 5-5/8 percent, four-months unchanged at 5-13/16 5-11/16, six-months unchanged at 5-15/16 5-13/16 and twelve-months unchanged at 6-5/16 6-3/16 percent.
